tools.name: query_tariff
tools.description: Search China 2026 import tariff schedule by HS code or keyword. Returns MFN/provisional/agreement/preferential/general rates. dataset optional.

tools.name: query_entity
tools.description: Search export control / sanctions entity lists (merged across lists). Use company or individual name.

tools.name: query_dualuse
tools.description: Search dual-use items & technologies: license catalogue (2026, HS-based) AND export control list (ECCN-coded, performance-threshold-based). Use HS code, ECCN code (e.g. 1C351), or technical description.

tools.name: query_fta_origin
tools.description: Search FTA product-specific rules of origin (25 agreements incl. RCEP, ASEAN, Korea) by HS code or product keyword.

tools.name: query_prohibited
tools.description: Search prohibited import/export goods catalogues (all batches) by keyword or HS code.

tools.name: query_any
tools.description: Auto-route query across all datasets. Best for ambiguous searches (e.g. 'lithium battery', '无人机').
